# Cartonry

> A packaging dieline generator that runs entirely in the browser. Type the internal
> size of a product and it draws the flat cutting template for a box that fits, with
> cut, crease and glue lines, panel sizes, and exports to SVG, PDF and DXF.

One page of static HTML and ES modules. Every measurement is computed locally; the
geometry never leaves the browser, and the tool keeps working offline once loaded.

## Box styles

- Regular Slotted Container (RSC, code 0201), free.
- Half Slotted Container, Full Overlap Slotted Container.
- Tuck-top mailer box, four-corner tray.

## Pages

- [The generator](https://cartonry.vercel.app/): dimensions, board, box style, and the drawing.
